fieldValues.title: The affirmation editor waits behind a blocker the queue cannot see: srs-rust#1473 has no epic and no plan
fieldValues.summary: srs-web#617 (inline tick or deny, the first part of the affirmation editor; P1; epic semanticops.com#29, which serves objectives ranked 2 and 4) is blocked by srs-programme#189 (comments 1.1.0; P1, ready, held blocked), which is blocked by srs-rust#1473 (write a new definition version beside the old; P1; owner-approved 2026-10-25). clerk flow --chain srs-rust#1473 shows no parent reaching a roadmap epic and no technical plan, so it is not in the queue and runs only as a probe. Nothing has moved on the chain since 2026-10-25; srs-programme#189 was auto-reclaimed on 2026-10-27 after an idle claim.
evidence: clerk queue (2026-10-28): neither srs-rust#1473 nor srs-web#617 queued; srs-programme#189 held
srs-web merges 2026-10-24..28: essay, ADR-027 layers, RecordProse, folder reads; none on #617
fieldValues.body:
- A blocker that is not shaped (no epic, no plan) is invisible to the queue, so everything it blocks waits with no signal, however high its own rank.
- The desk shows #617 and #189 as blocked, not why the chain does not move: its root is outside the queue.
- Joining the epic dot needs a Part of line; the plan needs a person or analyst.
